# web

The negative half of the `.astro` boundary, and the reason it sits in this directory
rather than beside it.

This file is a document: classified, routed to a reader, and read. It must **not**
appear in the `no recognised kind` line, even though it is in a directory whose other
files are entirely unclassified. An implementation that counted files by directory —
or that counted anything no reader produced facts for — would report it, and a
coverage line that fires on every README is a line nobody reads.
